subject: Production WebSocket lockup during ramp — HexaRetail
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@hexaretail.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-15T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Live tier — repeated socket freeze during ramp

Olga,

We just hit a serious issue during a scheduled capacity ramp for our Black Friday test. Starting at ~09:50 PT we saw intermittent WebSocket hangups: the connection appears open but no token chunks are delivered for 10–30s, then the stream resumes with bursts. This caused our UI to show frozen chat responses and an uptick in 502s. Latency p50 is fine but p99 and error rate spiked.

I uploaded sample logs and a packet capture: hexaretail_sample_logs.tar.gz (attached). Key symptoms: repeated TCP retransmits coincident with autoscaler events, and chunked transfer pauses that align with a proxy CPU spike.

Can you escalate? Our CS and ops teams are receiving complaints from enterprise customers. We need a live war-room and immediate mitigation options — even a temporary workaround would help.

Requesting:
- Immediate triage and short-term mitigation (throttle, degrade to polling)
- Access if you need full logs
- Exec sync if this qualifies as an SLA incident

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
VP, Engineering — HexaRetail
[Attachment: hexaretail_sample_logs.tar.gz (1.2MB)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@hexaretail.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-15T10:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Live tier — repeated socket freeze during ramp

Sanjay —

Thanks for the fast heads-up and for attaching the logs. Sorry you're seeing this during a ramp. I'm looping in Marcus (SRE) and Evelyn (CS) so we can stand up a short war-room.

Immediate plan:
- Marcus: can you take a look at the proxy and streaming autoscaler metrics? Focus on p99 latency and socket buffer pressure around 09:45–10:05 PT.
- Evelyn/CS: I'll coordinate customer comms and confirm whether HexaRetail needs an official incident report/credits.
- Sanjay: please confirm we can ingest your full access logs and packet captures into our secured bucket for deeper analysis.

Proposed cadence: 30-min triage call at 10:35 PT (I'll send invite). If this looks like an SLA hit we'll escalate to execs with a short summary and remediation options.

Olga
Olga Petrov
Director, Technical Accounts — Redwood Inference
[Attachment referenced: hexaretail_sample_logs.tar.gz]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-15T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Live tier — repeated socket freeze during ramp

Olga — initial findings from quick triage:

Summary:
- Proxy layer (edge-proxy-v2) shows short periods of CPU saturation correlating with autoscaler pod churn. During those windows we observe TCP retransmits and a backlog that appears to block chunk flushes for ~10–25s.
- Kernel socket buffers are hitting high-water marks; application-level backpressure isn't propagating quickly enough.
- Errors: increased 502/504 and websocket protocol resets; not all requests fail — this is a tail behavior.

Immediate mitigations we can deploy (low-risk):
1) Reduce max concurrent streams per connection on the proxy (reduces head-of-line blocking).
2) Temporarily cap autoscaler burst to avoid rapid pod churn while we stabilize.
3) Enable a controlled fallback to short-polling for sessions that hit repeated silent-chunk windows (configurable per-customer).

I've attached a short extract of the request IDs showing the timing (prelim-sample-logs.txt). If HexaRetail approves access, we'll pull full packet captures and run a deeper kernel / proxy instrumentation pass.

I'll start a canary of mitigation (1) in us-west-2 in the next 10 minutes if Olga approves.

Marcus Lin
Senior SRE — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: prelim-sample-logs.txt]

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@hexaretail.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.legal@hexaretail.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Live tier — repeated socket freeze during ramp

Olga/Marcus —

Thanks for the quick response. You have permission to ingest the full captures. Alyssa (cc) is on legal for any compliance questions.

Notes from our side:
- We observed the most visible issues from 09:49–10:05 PT (approx).
- Autoscaler spikes were triggered by a synthetic ramp we ran (50% increase in concurrent sessions). The timing lines up.
- We are seeing end-user 502s and UI freezes; customers are starting to flag this to our support org. We will likely ask for credit calculations depending on final impact.

Please keep us posted on the canary and any immediate mitigations. We will stand by for the call.

Sanjay
VP, Engineering — HexaRetail

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-15T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Executive summary & short-term action items — HexaRetail socket freeze

Team —

Executive summary for leadership:
- Incident: production WebSocket chunk delivery stalls and connection resets during a planned capacity ramp for HexaRetail (09:49–10:05 PT). Customer-visible symptoms: UI freezes, increased 502/504s, p99 latency spike.
- Root cause (preliminary): proxy CPU/backpressure + rapid autoscaler churn causing short-lived socket buffer pressure and chunk flush delays.
- Impact: multiple enterprise sessions affected; HexaRetail is asking for incident remediation and a credit calculation. Potential SLA exposure for live tier.

Actions taken (completed):
- Ingested HexaRetail logs and packet captures (authorized).
- Deployed temporary proxy change to reduce max concurrent streams per connection (canary in us-west-2).
- Temporarily limited autoscaler burst for the impacted pool.
- CS comms drafted and sent (Evelyn).

Recommended next steps (0–48h):
1) Full kernel/proxy trace to confirm whether socket buffer exhaustion is purely transient or requires code-level flow control fixes (owner: Marcus).
2) Permanent mitigation design: better backpressure propagation and a conservative autoscaler hysteresis (owner: Networking/Infra).
3) Customer remediation: compute provisional service credit and propose a Root Cause Analysis call by EOD tomorrow (owner: Olga/Evelyn).

Related items: HubSpot deal HEX-4782 (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/6789123), Sentry issue link: https://sentry.redwood/issue/HEX-5023. Attached a 1-page exec brief for HexaRetail.

I'll schedule an exec sync if HexaRetail confirms SLA impact; recommend David or Rishi attend.

Olga Petrov
Director, Technical Accounts — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: exec-brief-hexaretail.pdf]
